prerequisites: Shared seeded entities lab openlaw-docs-41255c61-entities built from 3fa407e3, with the seeded Knowledge types and folders.
Reviewer fixtures from docs/documentation/batches/DOC-029/knowledge/fixtures/build-fixtures.py (fictional PDF and DOCX files), copied under run-specific DOC-029 knowledge names.
Nadia Haddad created the draft item (primary PDF, supporting DOCX, guidance) and a draft replacement through the API as fixtures.
Daniel Okafor added the deflection link in a separate Administrator context; Jonas Weber and Ravi Menon read in separate Business Portal contexts signed in with fresh magic links.
scenarios.expected: Only the intended published audience reaches the item and its files; later removal takes effect. Direct links do not bypass publication/audience checks, including links to supporting Documents.
scenarios.actual: 11 recorded steps passed with Nadia Haddad publishing (the first is an API fixture). While Draft and while published Legal Only, Jonas Weber and Ravi Menon in Business Portal sessions got 404 and were returned to /portal. Audience Everyone and Knowledge Item actions, Publish removed Draft and showed On the portal; no Portal link existed until Daniel Okafor used Settings, Intake, Deflection links, Add link with Target Knowledge item, the item, a Label and Placement Portal home (the draft replacement was not offered). Jonas followed the link under Before you submit, read the title and guidance, saw Documents before Guidance with the primary first, downloaded both files byte for byte, and had no staff or Version controls. A guidance edit and a new primary Version reached him on reload with no second Publish. Audience Legal Only opened Remove this from the portal? naming 1 deflection link; Cancel kept Everyone and Continue saved Legal Only. The link left the Portal home, the saved article address returned to /portal, and the article and both saved download addresses answered 404 for both readers, while the link stayed in Settings. Everyone restored access; Unpublish (same dialog) returned Draft with Audience Everyone and blocked access; Publish restored the existing link, article and downloads. The Knowledge list had no archived toggle. Archive with Replaced by marked the item Archived, disabled editing, kept guidance and Documents, removed the link, article and downloads, did not redirect the old Portal address to the replacement, and dropped the item from the list; the saved staff address reopened it and Restore returned it Published for Everyone with the link, article and downloads working. An archived item was not offered under Replaced by, and the list showed a newly created item only after a reload. A browser with no session was sent to /portal/login and got 401 for the article and a file.

prerequisites: Shared seeded entities lab openlaw-docs-41255c61-entities built from 3fa407e3, with the seeded Knowledge types and folders.
Reviewer fixtures from docs/documentation/batches/DOC-029/knowledge/fixtures/build-fixtures.py (fictional PDF and DOCX files), copied under run-specific DOC-029 knowledge names.
Jonas Weber and Ravi Menon each signed in to the Business Portal with a fresh magic link in this lab.
scenarios.expected: A Portal reader reaches a published Everyone item and its files, and nothing else.
scenarios.actual: Inside both publisher runs, Jonas Weber and Ravi Menon got 404 for the article and every saved download address, and were returned to /portal, while the item was Draft, published Legal Only, unpublished or archived. While it was published for Everyone, Jonas reached it from Before you submit, downloaded the primary PDF and supporting DOCX byte for byte, got the new current Version after a live edit, and had no staff controls; Ravi's article read answered 200.

limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author and the technical reviewer; not a human user study and not the feature owner's approval.

The entities lab is shared with other DOC-029 agents. Only records named DOC-029 knowledge were created. The run added two Portal home deflection links and removed them at the end, and archived its published Everyone fixtures. Development runs before the recorded run E48831 are not credited (see harnessNotes in the walkthrough log).

The publication fixtures (item, Documents, guidance, replacement and archived replacement) were created through the API; the guide's own controls were used for Audience, Publish, Unpublish, Archive, Restore, the deflection link, the guidance edit and the new Version.
Only Placement Portal home was exercised; a request-type placement was read from source only.
The walkthrough ran on app commit 3fa407e3, which differs from edition.json supportedAppCommit 7f7e917a; the edition re-pin is outside this record.
